jobs.description:
Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Are you an experienced procurement professional looking to make an impact in a dynamic international aviation environment? As a Senior Purchaser, you will play a key role in ensuring the availability of critical parts and materials that keep our helicopter operations running safely and efficiently worldwide.

Acting as the link between operational departments and our supplier network, you will balance urgent operational requirements with commercial performance, supply continuity, quality, lead times and cost efficiency. In addition to day-to-day purchasing activities, you will help drive continuous improvement across our procurement processes, supplier strategies and supply chain performance.

👉Please note that this is an expression of interest only. We are currently building a talent pool for future opportunities and are not actively recruiting for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Managing strategically important supplier relationships and acting as the main point of contact for supplier-related matters. 

• 
Driving supplier performance improvements focused on service levels, lead times, cost efficiency and overall performance.

• 
Collaborating with internal stakeholders to resolve supplier performance issues and ensure continuity of supply. 

• 
Managing procurement activities, purchase orders and supplier agreements while ensuring compliance with agreed terms.

• 
Monitoring open purchase orders and proactively following up to avoid operational delays. 

• 
Maintaining accurate purchasing records and ERP system data.

• 
Providing support for Aircraft on Ground (AOG) situations and participating in the on-call rotation approximately every 4 to 5 weeks.

• 
Acting quickly on urgent procurement requests to minimize aircraft downtime. 

• 
Supporting the development of procurement processes, supplier strategies and supply chain initiatives.

• 
Identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, supplier performance and cost control across the organization.

We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded procurement professional who thrives in a fast-paced operational environment and enjoys building strong supplier relationships.

You bring:

• 
A bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience. 

• 
Previous experience in a purchasing role. 

• 
Experience working with ERP systems such as Navision or SAP. 

• 
Strong negotiation and influencing skills. 

• 
Professional proficiency in English; French is considered an advantage.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Good IT skills and digital literacy.

• 
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 

• 
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

• 
The ability to remain flexible and resilient under pressure.

• 
A collaborative approach and the ability to build strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Terms

• Freelance / Long-term

• Hybrid - Europe

• Occasional on-site travel

• Start: Before the end of 2026

• English-speaking

 

For a major insurance transformation programme, we are looking for an experienced freelance Product Owner with Insurance Package Implementation experience to join a greenfield Guidewire Cloud implementation within Commercial Insurance.

The client is looking to onboard Product Owners across both the PolicyCenter and ClaimCenter implementation teams.

The Product Owner will take ownership of their respective product domain, working closely with business stakeholders, Business Analysts, Solution Architects, configuration developers, and other members of a distributed Agile delivery team.
Responsibilities

• Own and manage the Product Backlog for PolicyCenter or ClaimCenter.

• Define and communicate product vision, priorities, and roadmap.

• Translate business objectives into epics, features, and user stories.

• Prioritise requirements based on business value, risk, and dependencies.

• Act as the key decision-maker for product-related questions and priorities.

• Work closely with stakeholders to define target business processes and desired outcomes.

• Collaborate with Guidewire configuration teams to ensure solutions align with business requirements.

• Participate in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Reviews, Refinements, and PI Planning.

• Support testing, user acceptance activities, and release planning.

• Ensure successful delivery of business value throughout the implementation lifecycle.

• Experience as a Product Owner within insurance transformation programmes.

• Previous experience with Guidewire or another core insurance platform implementation.

• Strong understanding of Policy Administration and/or Claims processes.

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments.

• Ability to engage with senior stakeholders and technology teams.

• Excellent communication and prioritisation skills.

 

Project Context

• Greenfield Guidewire Cloud implementation

• Focus on Commercial Insurance

• PolicyCenter and Product Definition at the core of the role

• Scrum team of approximately 10 people, including 3-4 Business Analysts and configuration developers

• International/distributed project environment

• First release currently moving into User Acceptance Testing

• Next release starts with an inception phase covering requirements, solution design and user-story backlog creation

• Earlier onboarding preferred to build project and policy knowledge ahead of the next major delivery phase

Are you ready to begin or further develop your career in procurement within an international aviation environment? As a Junior Purchaser, you help ensure that the parts and services needed for our base and line maintenance activities are available at the right time, in the right place and at the best possible cost.

Working closely with experienced purchasers, internal stakeholders and suppliers, you will support an accurate and reliable purchasing process. You will follow up open orders, maintain procurement data and help resolve delivery issues in accordance with our internal procedures.

👉Please note that this is an expression of interest only. We are currently building a talent pool for future opportunities and are not actively recruiting for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Creating and managing purchase orders while checking pricing, accuracy and compliance with agreed terms and internal procedures.

• 
Monitoring open purchase orders and following up with suppliers to support the timely delivery of parts and services.

• 
Maintaining accurate purchasing records, supplier information and data within our ERP and procurement systems.

• 
Identifying and escalating potential delays, discrepancies and supply risks.

• 
Acting as a day-to-day contact for suppliers regarding order status, delivery information and discrepancies.

• 
Supporting the resolution of late deliveries, shortages and other delivery-related issues.

• 
Assisting with supplier performance monitoring and collecting information for follow-up actions.

• 
Working closely with colleagues in purchasing, maintenance, logistics and other internal departments.

• 
Contributing ideas to improve order follow-up, data quality, team efficiency and service levels.

• 
Gradually building your procurement knowledge and taking ownership of purchasing activities.

You will also participate in the Aircraft on Ground, or AOG, on-call rotation approximately once every four to five weeks. During these time-critical situations, you will coordinate with suppliers, logistics providers and internal teams to help minimize aircraft downtime. This out-of-office-hours support can be provided remotely from home.

We are looking for an accurate, proactive and motivated colleague who is eager to learn and develop within an international procurement environment.

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.
You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.
